description: Main Roads WA - Intersections 2017 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Western Australia - Main Roads Western Australia. This layer shows intersections on the road network stored in the Integrated Road Information System (IRIS). An intersection is a road junction where two or more roads either meet or cross at grade (they are at the same level). The layer also details the IRIS Intersection Number. Coverage: Government of Western Australia - Main Roads Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Western Australia - Main Roads Western Australia. Its tags are WA, Western Australia, intersections, points, roads. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
